context.validated_for: Long-context marker retrieval and sustained generation with thinking disabled per request

caveats: Validated with thinking disabled per request. The same profile with thinking on retrieved correctly at 230K but failed sustained generation: at 147K and 183K prompt tokens the model spent the full 3,072-token output budget reasoning and returned no visible text in 2 of 3 attempts. The 16,384 server thinking cap is larger than that output budget, so give thinking-on requests at very long context a much larger max_tokens.
Prefill is serialised across requests: a 230K-token prompt takes about 4.5 minutes before the first token (~860 tok/s), and ~985 tok/s at 183K.
Measured with vision and 8 device state slots enabled; 14.5 / 14.1 GB per card. Two concurrent requests are configured, but this profile measured one request at a time.
Single machine. MTP draft acceptance at long context was ~0.52 on generated prose, lower than on short prompts.
